rules.name: Cathayan Black Powder
rules.description: The first time any unit in a Jade Fleet army that is armed with a handgun, a pistol, a brace of pistols, a repeater handgun, or a repeater pistol shoots the range of that weapon is increased by 3".

rules.name: Mercenary Handgun Drill
rules.description: Once per game, each unit or detachment of State Missile Troops in a Jade Fleet army can fire with one additional rank.

rules.name: Unity & Harmony
rules.description: Any unit of Jade Warriors or Jade Lancers within 3" of a friendly Mercenary unit may re-roll To Hit rolls of 1 during the Combat phase.

rules.name: War Balloons
rules.description: 0-1 Sky Lantern per 1,000 points may have the Ambushers special rule for +15 points. In addition, once per game a Sky Lantern that is held in reserve may re-roll the dice to determine if it arrives as reinforcements or is delayed.
